html:
The Kandozi are an Amazonian people of the Pastaza and Huitoyacu river region in Loreto, northern Peru, around Lake Rimachi. They speak Kandozi-Chapra, a language isolate with no known relatives, though they share many customs with the nearby Chicham peoples, such as the Achuar and Shiwiar.

They fish in the lakes and rivers, grow manioc and hunt. In recent decades the Kandozi have been hit hard by hepatitis B and D, and by oil work in the region. See Peru.
